phase: Same matched-context Stage1 pilot as validation_v3, with one candidate changed. v40 is v5 with the cashback-specific instructions removed from the shared body: the grant_kept_share section, the sentence that names accrual progress and the threshold, and one worked example whose reasoning acts out buying to clear a threshold. Every format-bearing character is unchanged - the anchor rules, the category vocabulary, the output schema and all fourteen JSON event examples are byte-identical to v5. v10 removed those examples and its contract rate fell from 66.7 to 7.3 per cent, with 167 of the violations being a missing "zone:" prefix, so this candidate does not touch them.
design: Identical frozen persona, synthetic Day0 state and date within each pair. Fiscal arms share environment. Distancing arms differ only in explicitly registered restrictions, not disease background. Read-only Neo4j; no rollout or database reset.
initial_state: 39 times daily_wd cash; mood=0.5, fatigue=0.3, energy=0.7, satisfaction=0.6; no prior memories or appointments. These are simulation initial conditions, not observed personal history.
cashback_seed: Monthly eligible spend seeded as daily weighted anchor * 0.268 * (day_of_month - 1), identically in off/on arms. Policy facts use experiment date as counterfactual start.
attribution_rule: In fiscal off arms flag trigger=policy AND reasoning mentioning P012/P013/P014/cashback/coupon/voucher/grant/local voucher. Environmental regulation attribution is allowed. This is a conservative screening flag, not a validated hallucination classifier; manually inspect flagged text before interpretation.
contract_checks: valid time and strictly increasing >=20 minute spacing
decision: This round judges the raw contract gate only. v5 is re-measured in the same run rather than compared against its earlier 128/192, because the served model may differ. A candidate is eligible for a macro run only if its strict contract rate is at least v5’s in this run. The registered 95 per cent gate is unchanged: if none reaches it, none passes, and a higher rate than v5 is not written up as passing.
inference: 12-person repeated matched-context pilot measures instruction execution and within-person decisions only. No spending outcome, causal macro effect, empirical magnitude score, or fresh holdout generalization claim.
holdout: P015 prohibited; already used. All four mechanisms are known development cases.
magnitude_future: Use simultaneous independent on/off rollouts, same dates and initial snapshots, independent run replicates. Report effect and interval; 0.5-2.0 empirical magnitude only when population, outcome definition, denominator and horizon match. Otherwise mark not comparable.
stop_rule: Run every preregistered cell once; preserve errors and raw outputs. No significance-based early stopping or silent retries. Failure of gate blocks automatic macro rollout.
predicted: v40 rises a little against v5: 658 characters that belong to a policy the cell may not carry are gone, so the format instructions sit relatively more prominently. v42 rises further and by more, because it addresses seventy-eight of the counted violations directly. If either falls, that is recorded as the result. v45 is expected to sit near v42: the change is vocabulary, not format. A fall would mean the wallet-shaped examples were carrying format weight, which is worth knowing.
not_changed: Sample, seeds, dates, cases, arms, temperature, token budget and every contract check are copied from validation_v3 unchanged. The 280-character truncation of policy descriptions is deliberately left in place so the comparison moves one variable.
amendment: A third candidate was added before any cell ran. v42 is v40 plus three fixes aimed at the defects counted in the stored pilot output: thirty-one events put a meal eaten at home or at work under the shop category, twenty-four wrote commuting as a zone anchor with the work category, and twenty-three spelled the field "reason" instead of "reasoning". None of the three adds emphasis. The first removes a contradiction the prompt already carried - it defines a meal as any meal in one line and demands the home category for meals at home in another - the second names a case the vocabulary never covered, and the third pins a field name. Chaining them as v5 -> v40 -> v42 keeps the two changes separable: v40 against v5 is the contamination, v42 against v40 is the format work. A fourth candidate was added, still before any cell ran. Counting the shared body again showed the removal had been one-sided: cashback words were gone but wallet ones were not - coupon four times, voucher three, policy balance six. A cashback policy has no wallet and a distancing rule has no benefit at all, so those words are contamination in exactly the way the cashback words were. v45 is v42 with them replaced by conditions rather than mechanism names, which also repairs a pointer: the runtime computes a remaining amount for wallet policies and a distance-to-threshold for the cashback one, and an instruction that says "balance" cannot point at the second. The ladder v5 -> v40 -> v42 -> v45 keeps every step separable.
